payload.text: RUL40 re-scope: herdr is never a source of truth or a delivery receipt for any fgOS state or Run outcome, but herdr's agent API (agent start / agent prompt --wait / agent wait / agent read / pane process-info) MAY be used by Dispatch as transport and as a failure detector (agent_not_ready, agent_prompt_stalled, blocked, agent absent). Truth stays with fgOS CLI state for Work and with receiver-written files (ack/result in the Run outbox) plus the liveness ladder for Runs. The former absolute ban on calling herdr agent start or reading agent_status is lifted; the ban on treating them as decision truth stays.
payload.rationale: The 2026-07-18 ban conflated two rules. The measured bug (idle kills agent, airemote) came from trusting idle as completion, not from calling the API. transport.mjs herdrSpawnInteractiveAdapter already reads agent_status as its only completion signal, violating the letter of RUL40 while being unstable (false idle at 3.5s, mid-turn dips ~25%, multi-line prompt corrupting pane run argv). Upstream beegog v2.33.2 proves the stable shape: herdr agent prompt --wait as atomic submit-and-observe, receipt = worker-written ack file, result file outranks every herdr signal, agent liveness from pane process-info. Full investigation: docs/architect/proposals/visibility-and-interactive-contact-herdr-spawn.md sections 3.3, 4, 8, 11, 14 (H1).
payload.alternatives: Keep the ban and stay on pane run + agent_status polling: rejected, it is the exact unstable path. Drop herdr for interactive dispatch and use agy -p in a pane (Family D): rejected by the user, herdr's only job is real TTY visibility (tsk-by0).

payload.title: Dispatched agent in a fresh worktree inherits broken hooks: .claude/settings.json is tracked (so…
payload.description: Dispatched agent in a fresh worktree inherits broken hooks: .claude/settings.json is tracked (so it lands in every worktree) and registers 12+ hooks at ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/*.cjs, but .gitignore line 58 (/.claude/*) means zero hook scripts are tracked. Measured 2026-09-06 in a live claude agent in a disposable worktree: every turn ended with 'Stop hook error: Cannot find module .../cook-after-plan-reminder.cjs'. Non-blocking this time, but four of the registrations are PreToolUse (privacy-block, scout-block, descriptive-name) where a crash could deny tool calls. Fix direction: a worker-marker env var that makes the repo's own hooks exit 0 silently for dispatched workers (upstream beegog solves this with BEE_HERDING_WORKER=1, herding-worker-standalone D1-D3), or ship a worker settings overlay. Evidence: docs/architect/proposals/visibility-and-interactive-contact-herdr-spawn.md section 12c row F19. Verify: dispatch a claude agent into a fresh worktree and confirm no hook error appears in the pane for a full turn.

payload.text: tsk-53j closed as wontfix: the dispatch-control-plane-redesign.md section 12.2 drift is folded into the V0 implementation plan's own docs-update step instead of standing as a separate item.
payload.rationale: Section 12.2 describes the pre-tsk-by0 adapter shape (temp script + runner-owned sentinel after command exit). Any V0 implementation rewrites that section anyway, so a separate item creates a second place to remember one edit. Already recorded as a required doc update in docs/architect/proposals/visibility-and-interactive-contact-herdr-spawn.md section 13.

payload.text: tsk-hem fixed by guarding each hook registration instead of by a worker-marker env: the 21 commands in .claude/settings.json that point at gitignored .claude/hooks/*.cjs now check for the script and exit 0 when it is absent, otherwise exec it unchanged. Committed on branch visibility-herdr-spawn-investigation (d5b2ace3), not yet merged.
payload.rationale: The item's own suggested direction (a worker marker every hook respects) would require editing kit-owned scripts that no hook currently reads an env var from, and would only cover dispatched workers while leaving a human's own worktree still crashing. Guarding the registration fixes both cases and preserves current behaviour exactly where the scripts exist. An in-process import shim was rejected: 3 of 14 scripts guard on require.main === module, so importing them would make them silently not run, and one of those is privacy-block. Shell execution of hook commands was verified live, not assumed. Proof: docs/architect/agent-coordination/verification/visibility-herdr/proofs/2026-09-06-hem/.
payload.alternatives: Track .claude/hooks/*.cjs: rejected, they are kit-generated artifacts that churn. Move the registrations to the untracked settings.local.json: cleaner conceptually but changes the repo's config-sharing policy and costs a human their hooks inside their own worktree; left as the user's call, noted in the phase file.

patch.description:
Give executors.codex-herdr a real interactiveMode path (like agy-herdr, tsk-10j precedent), instead of leaving it dormant/dead after tsk-by0 removed herdr-spawn's plain/liveOutput mechanism. codex-herdr's own config description already flags this as unverified: whether codex exec streams live text by default or buffers is UNVERIFIED (deliberately deferred, not guessed). Scope: research whether codex exec (or a codex flag) supports a genuine interactive/TUI session compatible with herdr's agent_status-polling completion-detection scheme the way agy's -i does; if yes, implement + flip config + real live-binary proof (dispatch a real prompt, confirm real work happens, not just an idle banner -- same bar tsk-2rr's own bug proved was necessary for agy-herdr); if codex has no such mode, report that finding and this item resolves as wontfix/blocked rather than forcing a fake interactiveMode. Priority: do this first, per explicit user instruction (2026-08-27), ahead of glm and every other dormant herdr executor.

--- Premise changed 2026-09-07 (commit a12abcf3, dispatch-visibility-v0 Phase 02) ---

The agent_status-polling completion-detection scheme this item's scope is written against NO LONGER EXISTS. herdr-spawn now starts the worker with "herdr agent start <name> --kind <kind> --pane <pane>" and concludes a round from a file the worker itself wrote (outbox/result-<round>.json); agent_status is not read as completion anywhere. So the central research question -- "is codex exec compatible with herdr's agent_status-polling scheme the way agy -i is" -- is moot as written.

The work itself is NOT done: executors.codex-herdr still declares no interactiveMode, so the adapter still refuses it. But the bar is now narrower and cheaper: (1) herdr 0.8.2's own --kind list already includes "codex", so startup is a config line rather than a research question; (2) the only real unknown left is whether a codex interactive session, given a one-line pointer to brief-<round>.md, will write the ack/report/result files the brief asks for. The live-proof bar is unchanged (a real dispatch doing real work, never an idle banner -- the standard tsk-2rr's own bug established).

Re-scope this item's description before working it; do not start from the agent_status research question.

Follow-up cleanup for the remaining dormant herdr-spawn executors after tsk-by0 removed the plain/liveOutput mechanism: executors.claude-herdr and executors.pi-herdr currently declare liveOutput (now dead -- herdr-spawn requires interactiveMode and throws otherwise). For each: either give it a real interactiveMode path with live-binary proof (same bar as agy-herdr/tsk-10j, codex-herdr/tsk-36a, glm-herdr/tsk-612), or delete the dead entry outright if no genuine interactive mode exists for that CLI. Also do a final repo-wide sweep for any other leftover reference to herdr-spawn's removed plain/liveOutput shape (docs, comments, other config) that tsk-by0's own removal did not already catch. Priority: lowest of the herdr-interactiveMode work -- after codex-herdr (tsk-36a) and glm-herdr (tsk-612), per explicit user instruction (2026-08-27).

--- Premise changed 2026-09-07 (commit a12abcf3, dispatch-visibility-v0 Phase 02) ---

Still accurate: executors.claude-herdr and executors.pi-herdr declare liveOutput (dead) and no interactiveMode, so herdr-spawn refuses both.

What changed is the bar this item points at. "Same bar as agy-herdr/tsk-10j" now names a mechanism that has been deleted: the pane-run startup path, the exit sentinel, and agent_status-as-completion are all gone. Giving an executor a real interactive path today means declaring interactiveMode (exitCommand, and kind when the command basename does not already name a herdr agent kind) and proving that the agent, given a one-line pointer to brief-<round>.md, writes the ack/report/result files.

The repo-wide sweep this item also asks for should now include leftover references to the REMOVED shape as well: "pane run" as a startup path, exit sentinels, and any doc or comment describing agent_status as a completion signal.

Add a docs/how-to guide for configuring a runner executor to dispatch via the herdr-spawn adapter: add an executors.<id> entry with invocations[].adapter set to "herdr-spawn" (reusing an existing CLI invocation shape like the claude executor), then point a capabilities.<name>.prefer at it so that capability's dispatch runs visibly inside a fresh Herdr pane instead of a captured cli-spawn subprocess. No such how-to exists yet even though the adapter itself (src/runner/dispatch/transport.mjs herdrSpawnAdapter) has been merged and tested since tsk-5x7.

--- Config surface changed 2026-09-07 (commit a12abcf3, dispatch-visibility-v0 Phase 02) ---

A how-to written against the pre-a12abcf3 shape would be wrong on the day it lands. What an executor may now declare:

- interactiveMode.kind -- which herdr agent kind to start; defaults to the command basename.
- interactiveMode.promptTimeoutMs -- refused below 10000ms, because a shorter deadline fires before herdr's own 5000ms stall detector can report the reason.
- interactiveMode.readyTimeoutMs, resendAfterMs, maxResends.
- promptDelivery (executor or invocation level) -- "file-pointer" (default: the prompt goes to brief-<round>.md and only a one-line pointer is typed) or "inline".

The guide should also say plainly what the adapter now concludes from what: a round ends when the worker's own outbox/result-<round>.json appears, never on an agent status; and a failed dispatch keeps its pane open with a named reason (agent_not_ready, agent_prompt_stalled, agent_blocked).

payload.title: executors.claude-bwrap and executors.agy-bwrap exist ONLY as uncommitted working-tree state in the…
payload.description:
executors.claude-bwrap and executors.agy-bwrap exist ONLY as uncommitted working-tree state in the main checkout's .fgos/config.json -- no commit on any branch has ever put them there, so the architecture-advisory-panel track's own read-only-confined dispatch pair is one careless .fgos sweep away from vanishing, and a fresh clone of this repo does not have it at all.

Measured 2026-09-07, three commands, all from a worktree of this repo:
- `git log --all --oneline -S "claude-bwrap" -- .fgos/` returns NOTHING. No commit on any branch has ever added that string under .fgos/.
- `git show main:.fgos/config.json | grep -c claude-bwrap` = 0; same for group-thinking-plan-loop and for dispatch-visibility-v0. The entries are live only in /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/.fgos/config.json on this machine.
- The commits that DO mention claude-bwrap (b5cc763e, 32ef2dd6, a5112f76, 34b8a941, 78000931) are architecture-advisory-panel docs/skills, not the config entry itself.

This matches the known constraint rather than contradicting it: ADR0020 blocks a worker branch from committing under .fgos/, so config changes have to land as a direct main-checkout commit (the tsk-2ii / tsk-4zi pattern already documented in docs/explanation/herdr-spawn-adapter-fresh-pane.md). For this pair that landing step appears never to have happened.

Second defect, same pair, worth fixing in the same change: both entries hardcode an absolute machine-specific path in their bwrap args -- `--bind /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/.fgos/assignments /home/vantt/projects/forgentX/.fgos/assignments`. On any other machine, any other checkout, or a renamed directory, that bind names a path that does not exist while `--ro-bind / /` still makes everything else read-only, so the writable exception the pair depends on silently is not there. The executors would appear configured and fail to produce agent-result.json.

Third, a stale record rather than a defect: tsk-1o4 says dispatch.mjs decide/execute treats claude-bwrap, agy-bwrap and codex-readonly as unregistered. That is no longer true -- `node src/runner/dispatch.mjs decide claude-bwrap` now answers {"mechanism":"out-of-process","configured":true}. tsk-1o4 is still at status todo and should be re-checked or closed.

Not touched by the reporter: this item was written from the dispatch-visibility-v0 track, which owns none of these executors and made zero commits under .fgos/ (verified: `git log --oneline main..HEAD --name-only | grep -c "^\.fgos/"` = 0). The fix belongs to whoever owns the advisory-panel dispatch pair. Reported rather than fixed because .fgos/config.json is shared state and this pair is another track's asset.

Suggested verify: after the fix, `git show main:.fgos/config.json | grep -c claude-bwrap` is non-zero, and the bwrap --bind path is derived at dispatch time from the resolved repo root rather than written literally.

payload.title: approve's pull/legacy path reports "goal-check failed on main" while verifying a completely…
payload.description:
approve's pull/legacy path reports "goal-check failed on main" while verifying a completely different branch: its worktree guards check WHERE the checkout is, never WHICH BRANCH it has out, so a main checkout sitting on a feature branch is verified as if it were main.

Live 2026-09-07, twice, reproducible: `node bin/fgos.mjs approve tsk-hem` run from the main checkout parked the item blocked with reason verify-fail and detail "goal-check failed on main (exit 127)". The main checkout was on group-thinking-plan-loop (00c851bf) the whole time; main was at dc131ddb. The item's fix and its verify script are both on main and neither is on that branch, so goal-check ran against a tree that has never seen either.

The first run failed exit 127 because the item's verify field still held a placeholder sentence ("chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung") which goal-check executes as a shell command -- a separate, smaller defect, since a placeholder in `verify` becomes "command not found" rather than anything a reader can act on. After giving the item a real verify command the second run failed MODULE_NOT_FOUND on that script, which is what exposed the branch problem: the script exists on main and the checkout was not on main.

approve.mjs already reasons about exactly this hazard for the neighbouring case. Its own comment at the worktree guard says: "pull/legacy: runGoalCheck below verifies whatever cwd has checked out; a session worktree sits at its startCommit, which may predate later advances to main, so this would verify STALE code while the 'verified on main' message claims otherwise, marking the item done regardless -- a silent false verification." Both guards below that comment (the sessions.json registry loop and the structural isMainWorktree check) test the checkout's identity as a worktree. Neither tests its HEAD. The main worktree on a feature branch passes both and reaches runGoalCheck.

Why this is worse than a confusing message: the failing direction is loud, but the passing direction is silent. A feature branch whose tree happens to satisfy the item's verify command would mark the item delivered and report it "verified on main" having verified no such thing -- the identical false verification the comment was written to prevent, arrived at through the one door the guards do not cover.

Suggested fix: before runGoalCheck on the pull/legacy path, assert the checkout's HEAD actually is main (git symbolic-ref --short HEAD, compared against the configured trunk) and refuse by name when it is not, the same way the worktree guards refuse -- "approve: refusing to verify on main from a checkout that has <branch> out". Refusing costs a person one branch switch; not refusing costs a silent false delivery. Worth pairing with a second, independent check: an item whose `verify` is still a placeholder should be refused before anything is executed, rather than shelled out and reported as exit 127.

Found while landing the dispatch-visibility-v0 track. Not fixed here: approve/merge is not this track's area, and the repro needs the main checkout, which is currently occupied by another track's branch.

patch.title: Dispatch không xác minh worker ghi trong cwd của nó -- nửa phát hiện đã làm (819a61e5), còn nửa…
patch.description:
Dispatch xác minh worker LÀM XONG, nhưng không xác minh LÀM Ở ĐÂU. Round settle khi worker ghi result file của chính nó — điều đó chứng minh worker có làm, không chứng minh nó làm trong workspace được giao.

ĐO ĐƯỢC (2026-09-07): dispatch fgos-coding-implement qua agy-herdr, giao worktree .claude/worktrees/tsk-1fp-2-OmCN4o. agy khai "settled" với evidenceRefs liệt kê 4 file. Bốn file đó không có trong worktree — chúng nằm trong MAIN CHECKOUT, trên nhánh group-thinking-plan-loop của track khác. Tổng cộng 4 file tạo mới + 2 file tracked bị sửa (docs/architecture-manifest.json thêm 2 dòng).

Harness không sai: herdr agent get và fgos dispatch show-run đều báo cwd của agent là worktree. agy tự đi ra ngoài cwd của nó. Đây là lần thứ hai — lần trước đã ghi nhận "agy ignored spawn cwd once, committed to an unrelated claimed item's branch instead".

HẬU QUẢ THẬT, KHÔNG PHẢI GIẢ ĐỊNH (2026-09-08): hai dòng manifest lọt qua khâu giải xung đột của merge group-thinking-plan-loop vào main. Chúng phá vỡ bất biến 1:1 disk<->row và one-way-import-direction (test/architecture.test.mjs) — hai regression thật vào main. Một phiên khác phải truy ra và sửa ở commit 5b965b0a, mô tả nó là "stale uncommitted local cruft" mà không biết nguồn gốc.

ĐÃ LÀM — nửa PHÁT HIỆN (commit 819a61e5): cả hai cửa dispatch so dirty paths của repo root trước/sau vòng chạy; round khai settled mà có đường dẫn ngoài workspace xuất hiện thì bị từ chối với errorClass worktree-fail, reason wrote-outside-workspace, và nêu đích danh đường dẫn. Đường dẫn tại/dưới workspace không tính (fgOS đặt worktree BÊN TRONG repo root); dirt có sẵn trước round không đổ cho worker. Đây là bằng chứng chứ không phải chứng minh — repo root là cây sống, phiên khác có thể làm bẩn — nên lời từ chối nói quan sát được gì, không khẳng định ai làm.

CÒN LẠI — nửa NGĂN CHẶN: làm cho worker KHÔNG THỂ ghi ra ngoài, thay vì chỉ bắt được sau. Đã đo khả thi (docs/architect/agent-coordination/verification/visibility-herdr/proofs/2026-09-08-bwrap/):
- bwrap confine được nhưng herdr TỪ CHỐI pane (agent_pane_busy) — bwrap phải fork nên pid shell lệch khỏi pid herdr ghi nhận; có đối chứng: pane thường match True, pane bwrap match False.
- unshare --mount --map-root-user confine tương đương VÀ giữ nguyên pid; herdr nhận pane, agy đạt agent_status "idle" bên trong.
- Cạm bẫy đã đo: --tmpfs /tmp đặt sau bind sẽ XOÁ HOME riêng của worker (createWorkerHome đặt HOME dưới os.tmpdir()); bind mount kế thừa cờ ro nên phải remount,bind,rw riêng một bước, thiếu nó thì mọi thứ read-only và trông như "confinement hoạt động".

Chưa đo: agy có làm được việc thật trong namespace không (mới tới bước khởi động), provider khác, landlock (kernel có bật), và read isolation (cả hai cách đều để toàn bộ filesystem ĐỌC được).

Liên quan: tsk-40v (executors.claude-bwrap/agy-bwrap chỉ tồn tại dạng working-tree, đường dẫn hardcode, đang là cli-spawn headless).
